Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Momentum's Edge
Unique master. Only usable if you have one or more victory points.
Put this card in play. You may tap this card during your untap phase to gain 1 pool.

Gambit Accepted
Master. Only usable if you have at least 1 victory point. Lose 1 victory point and put this card in play. During your untap phase, move 1 pool from your prey's pool to your pool. If you are ousted, your predator gains an additional victory point. At the end of the game, if you have not been ousted, you gain an additional victory point.

So, just to be sure: I can play Momentum's Edge "anytime", but use it only, if I have at least one VP - right?
And if I have one VP and sacrifice it to play Gambit Accepted, then I won't be able to use a played Momentum's Edge until I have won a new VP - right?

Both require you to have 1 VP in order to play them. The "usable" refers to the fact of playing the master, not using it afterwards (otherwise Gambit Accepted would require 2 vps to be tapped and used to steal 1 pool).

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
You would need to play Momentum's Edge BEFORE playing Gambit Accepted.
Both require you to have 1 VP, but Gambit Accepted will make you lose 1VP as you put the card into play.

Once they are in play, you may use the effect of this card any time.
I've been thinking of playing some more of both cards honestly, they seem very useful. Just like Edge of the World... a card I do love for its serious GRUNT but appropriate restrictions.
